output.body: Think of a set of Russian nesting dolls. To find the smallest doll, you open the largest one, which reveals a slightly smaller doll inside. You repeat that exact same action—opening the doll—until you get to the one that doesn't open.
output.key_idea: Recursion solves a problem by calling itself on smaller and smaller versions of the same problem.
output.question: In that nesting doll analogy, what would happen if there was no smallest doll?
